title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, first model rated 'Critical' for cyber
summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra to limited partners, then paid tiers, claiming top computer-use and math scores; it is the first OpenAI model at its Critical cybersecurity threshold.
reason: New frontier model with notable gains and dangerous cyber capability; self-reported benchmarks.

title: Wave of frontier releases: Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen3.8-Max
summary: Anthropic, Google DeepMind (including a defenders-only Cyber variant), Alibaba and Meta shipped model updates in the same week.

title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9B
summary: Nvidia signed a definitive deal to acquire the main open-model hub for $11.9B cash plus about $1B in retention equity, pledging to keep it open to rival chips; closing expected H1 2027.
reason: Dominant chip vendor buys key open-source infrastructure; big acquisition per F5 T2.

title: Sanders and Casar introduce bill to ban artificial superintelligence
summary: The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act would permanently ban superintelligent AI, pause advanced AI research until federal safety rules exist and create a cabinet-level oversight agency.
reason: High-profile ban proposal citing the OpenAI agent breach; not law.

title: Uber aligns with driver unions to slow robotaxi rollout
summary: The FT reported Uber is backing rules to keep human drivers in its network as autonomous fleets grow.
reason: Platform supports job protections against automation.

title: Revelio: AI-exposed jobs for workers 22-25 down 19% relative
summary: Revelio Labs' August tracker found employment in the most AI-exposed occupations about 6% lower than least-exposed since late 2022, and 19% lower for ages 22-25, but no broad displacement yet.
reason: Uneven youth impact; no broad shock.
